# FC-Estimator (v4.2.0) — Calibrated Function-Count Algebraic Build & Token-Economics Engine (MIT)

> Open-source pre-build software sizing CLI, MCP server, Claude/Cursor skill, and interactive web calculator by Collins Takem (RASA-X-MACHINA). Predicts autonomous build wall-clock minutes, <=8-FFP microservice topology, and Build Law 8.8x EUR token savings at 95.0% validated accuracy.
